s1.syndrome_frame: Cardiac dysfunction with possible infiltrative or obstructive process in the setting of a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology on ECG
Diffuse medium masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram
key_facts: Patient is in their 70s
History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
Treated with 8 courses of chemotherapy 4 years ago
No history of structural heart disease or hypertension
Blood pressure is 96/54 mm Hg
Heart rate is 56 bpm
Serum troponin I is 0.04 ng/mL
NT-proBNP is 3896.83 pg/mL
ECG shows prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology
Transthoracic echocardiogram reveals diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
PET-CT scan shows increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium
